name: orin
description: A lightweight desktop harness for any LLM: subscriptions, API keys, local models, and MCP connectors. Runs on macOS 12+.

scripts.package:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip
scripts.package:mac:release: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip -c.mac.forceCodeSigning=true

extendInfo.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: Orin accesses project folders you choose in Downloads so your coding agent can read and edit their files.
extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: Orin accesses project folders you choose in Documents so your coding agent can read and edit their files.
extendInfo.NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: Orin accesses project folders you choose on Desktop so your coding agent can read and edit their files.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Orin uses the microphone for voice input. Speech is turned into text on this Mac and is not sent anywhere.
extendInfo.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Orin turns your speech into text on this Mac for voice input. Audio is not sent anywhere.

author: Moosa Yousaf
